meta.name: MTU compliance placement x output-mode A/B

source.notes: Derived from the first Term-to-Term replacement exchange; facts tightened while preserving the actual case shape.

turns.text: I have an MTU BOR case. Existing plan: Prudential PruTerm, Term Life, S$300,000 death/TPD, premium S$1,200 yearly, coverage to age 65. Proposed: Elite Term (All Riders), Term Life, S$500,000 death/TPD/CI, premium S$1,500 yearly, coverage to age 70. This replaces PruTerm. The client wants CI cover and a longer term. Draft the BOR.
expected_before_next: asks one compact question only for the explicit yes/no 50%-of-surplus answer
does not ask for rationale, alternatives, replacement-disadvantages wording, income or surplus, reference number, arithmetic, or comparison freshness

turns.text: Total annual premiums do not exceed 50% of the client's surplus. Draft it.

expected.label: drafts the supported Term-to-Term ROP BOR after receiving the sole missing material answer
does not ask for any standard narrative default or never-ask item
includes the exact does-not-exceed sustainability sentence
expected.text: Total annual premiums do not exceed 50% of the client's surplus.

expected.label: does not invert the sustainability declaration
expected.text: Client has catered enough savings and emergency funds for unforeseen circumstances, and is comfortable to proceed even though the premium amount is more than 50% of their surplus.

expected.label: includes exact ROP disadvantage point 1
expected.text: 1. May incur penalties / transaction costs for terminating the existing policy(ies) or investment product(s), without gaining any real benefit from replacing them.

expected.label: includes exact ROP disadvantage point 2
expected.text: 2. Financial benefits accumulated over the years may be lost.

expected.label: includes exact ROP disadvantage point 3
expected.text: 3. May be offered a lower level of benefit at a higher or same cost (or the same benefit at higher cost); the new policy may be less suitable.

expected.label: includes exact ROP disadvantage point 4
expected.text: 4. If existing medical conditions are covered by the existing plan, coverage for those conditions may be lost.

expected.label: contains no Markdown asterisks
contains no Markdown heading markers
does not expose an internal coverage recap
does not end with a closing offer

provenance.standard_ref: R02, R13, R15; mtu_constitution.yaml response_policy.enforced_sentences and BOR generation instructions

source.notes: Locks in the useful Voyage shorthand, non-ROP, disclosure, and formatting behavior while preventing the observed invented future-shortfall intention.

turns.text: New BOR. No existing plans. Voyage 15pay, no riders, Franklin Income Fund 100%, S$12,000 per year. Client failed CKA and has a balanced risk profile. Total annual premiums do not exceed 50% of the client's surplus.

expected.label: drafts the supported non-ROP Voyage BOR without asking what Voyage 15pay means
identifies HSBC Life Wealth Voyage and the 15-year minimum investment period
states the CKA result and balanced risk profile once without additional regulatory logic
does not present Franklin Income Fund's pending classification as definitively Melody-approved
includes a concise Melody flag for the pending Franklin Income Fund classification while still drafting
includes one closing check line for any case-varying start-up bonus or promotion/gift wording without inventing values
uses the exact does-not-exceed sustainability sentence

expected.label: includes the first exact general disclosure
